newsitem.title: INDIA: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.
newsitem.headline: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it placed the following securities in its "portfolio watch" representing stocks that are likely to outperform the market.
Security Residual Modified Net Price Yield Weightage

As mentioned in the previous report, returns on the portfolio should be evaluated over one month's time frame. The curve spread between three year and seven year gilts at more than 100 basis points is fairly steep and this spread is likely to tighten over the next fortnight. Also, yields at the short end having dropped steeply over the past fortnight, buying interest is expected to shift to the medium and longer end of the curve. Hence the portfolio recommended for the next fortnight is the same as the one for the second fortnight of June.
